run_grammar_constrained_generation: run grammar-constrained text generation using an EBNF grammar file with a pretrained GPT-2 model
create_incremental_grammar_constraint: create an IncrementalGrammarConstraint from an EBNF grammar string to constrain token generation
build_grammar_logits_processor: build a GrammarConstrainedLogitsProcessor to enforce grammar rules during model generation
generate_chinese_from_english: generate Chinese translations from English prompts using grammar-constrained causal language model inference
decode_batched_tokens: decode batched token IDs back to text strings using the tokenizer batch_decode method
